Sample ledger (free).what_this_is: A fixed practice dataset. Everybody gets this same one. It does not start your clock, does not need your key, and is not rate limited.
Sample ledger (free).how_to_use_it: Fold it exactly as stage one asks. If your pipeline produces the answer below, your fold handles all six event types and both format traps, and you are ready to fetch your own ledger.
